title: Lesson 4: PyTorch basics — Tensor & Autograd in depth — js-tools
desc: The fourth lesson of the Practical AI Engineer roadmap. The Tensor data structure and how to move it onto a GPU (CUDA/MPS), reshaping and memory contiguity, and how PyTorch’s Autograd engine builds a computation graph so it can differentiate your code for you — ending in a training loop written by hand that fits a cubic to a sine curve.
